name: 1inch Fusion v1 Settlement calldata corruption (resolver drain)
summary: Settlement._settleOrder() used the attacker-supplied interactionLength in unchecked Yul pointer arithmetic. A wrapped length moved the appended suffix backward in memory, overwriting the authenticated resolver field, so the deprecated Fusion v1 contract called a third-party resolver and spent its standing token approvals.
notes: The campaign is the original attacker's TrustedVolumes drains plus copycats who kept forging resolvers through the same Settlement into late 2026 to spend dust approvals of other resolvers and users: every later settleOrders call in which some third party only lost assets. Settlement's own balance is a pass-through and is not counted as a victim.
873 tokens worth under $1,000 each are summed into one entry. Most funds were later returned to TrustedVolumes for a bounty; recovery is not netted.
